feature: Add Date Range Filter to Material and Supplier Lists
workflow_rationale: Simple workflow chosen because: 1) Single service (Django backend), 2) Following established pattern from inventory movements, 3) No new models or complex logic, 4) Just extending existing list views with filters

phases.name: Add Date Range Filters
phases.description: Add date range filtering to material_list and supplier_list views and templates

subtasks.description: Add date range filter to material_list view
subtasks.implementation_notes: Follow the pattern from movements_list() in inventory/views.py lines 158-193. Add: 1) Retrieve date_from and date_to from request.GET, 2) Parse dates with datetime.strptime and try-except, 3) Filter queryset with created_at__date__gte and created_at__date__lte, 4) Add date_from and date_to to context

verification.instructions: 1) Run Django server, 2) Navigate to materials list page, 3) Test date filters work correctly, 4) Verify error handling for invalid dates

subtasks.notes: Added date range filter (date_from and date_to) to material_list view following the pattern from inventory/views.py. Includes proper date parsing with error handling for invalid dates. The filter values are passed to the template context for UI display.

subtasks.description: Add date range filter to supplier_list view
subtasks.implementation_notes: Follow the same pattern as subtask-1-1. Add: 1) Retrieve date_from and date_to from request.GET, 2) Parse dates with datetime.strptime and try-except, 3) Filter queryset with created_at__date__gte and created_at__date__lte, 4) Add date_from and date_to to context

verification.instructions: 1) Run Django server, 2) Navigate to suppliers list page, 3) Test date filters work correctly, 4) Verify error handling for invalid dates

subtasks.notes: Successfully added date range filtering to supplier_list view. Follows the same pattern as material_list with date_from and date_to parameters. Includes error handling for invalid date formats.

subtasks.description: Add date range inputs to material_list template
subtasks.implementation_notes: Follow pattern from movements_list.html lines 65-70. Add: 1) Two date input fields in the filter form section (lines 32-79), 2) Update pagination links to preserve date_from and date_to parameters (lines 171-207)
subtasks.notes: Added date range inputs (date_from and date_to) to material_list template following the patterns from movements_list.html and bin_list.html. Updated all pagination links to preserve date filter values. Added "Clear Filters" button as seen in reference files.

subtasks.description: Add date range inputs to supplier_list template
subtasks.implementation_notes: Follow pattern from movements_list.html lines 65-70. Add: 1) Two date input fields in the filter form section (lines 31-64), 2) Update pagination links to preserve date_from and date_to parameters (lines 161-200)
subtasks.notes: Added date_from and date_to input fields to supplier_list template following patterns from movements_list.html and bin_list.html. Updated all pagination links to preserve date filter values.

acceptance_criteria: Date range filters work correctly on material_list view
Date range filters work correctly on supplier_list view
Date inputs render properly in both templates
Invalid date inputs are handled gracefully without errors
